resources.string: This save needs a newer version of Parlor. Update the app, then try again. The saved files have been kept.
Your saved settings could not be read. Try again after checking the available storage. Your progress files have been kept.
Your saved progress could not be read. The files have been kept for recovery. Try again or close Parlor. Avoid clearing app data or uninstalling, which removes local saves.
Your saved progress is temporarily unavailable. Check the available storage, then try again. The saved files have been kept.

Appearance, sound, motion, timer and tutorial preferences will return to their defaults. A private copy of the previous settings file will be kept on this device first. Progress, puzzle photos, reminders and saved records are unchanged.
Saving the previous settings and applying defaults. This continues if you close this screen.
The settings reset could not finish. Your progress files are unchanged. Check the available storage, then try again.
Choose your own photo from any Sliding Tiles campaign board for free. A square copy is saved privately, so the board still works if the original photo is moved or deleted.

Saved photos are included in progress backups. Android automatic backup skips collections over 25 MB; save a manual backup for a large collection. Parlor does not send photos to its services or crash reports.

All puzzle and local recovery photo copies will be removed, including any previous damaged save kept during recovery. Your current boards keep their moves and scores and return to default artwork. Original photos and backup files you already exported are unchanged.
This backup will become your active progress and settings. The damaged save will be kept privately on this device. Only one previous damaged save is kept; an earlier recovery copy may be replaced.

Saved reward limits, used hints and completion claims are retained. Some unfinished attempts may be omitted and hint balances may be lower than the backup shows. Hints and every feature remain free. Your reminder choices stay unchanged.
Backup restoration is free and needs no store connection.

The separate reward safeguards could not be read. A backup cannot be restored safely without them. The saved files have been kept. Try again after checking storage, or update Parlor if this save came from a newer version.
Recovery could not finish. Check the available storage, then retry or choose the backup again. The damaged save has been kept.
Preparing your restored progress. This continues if you close this screen.
The photos could not be deleted. Please try again.
Save your progress, settings and puzzle photos in one file, or bring them back from a Parlor backup.
Backups contain your progress, settings and puzzle photos. Notification permission stays on this device.
Saving and importing progress files is free.
Checking the backup. Your current progress stays saved.
Restoring progress and settings. Please wait for this step to finish.
Your progress and settings are restored.
The backup could not be read or saved. Choose a valid Parlor file from this app version, up to 32 MB, and check the available storage. An incomplete file is never imported.
Finish saving your earned reward before using backups. Return to Settings and retry saving.
This replaces your current boards, results and settings. Earned achievements and streak dates are kept. Your current progress is saved for recovery before anything is replaced.
A copy of your progress from before the last import is kept on this device. Restoring it also replaces changes made since then.
Your progress is saved. We need to finish restoring its settings before play resumes. The previous progress is also kept for recovery. Please free some storage if needed, then try again.
This daily puzzle is outside the saved 30-day history. Choose today’s challenge to continue.
We could not open your room. Your saved progress has been kept.
Google Play redemption could not be opened.
